messages.subject: Re: [TMB users] Matrix exponential
parts:
RTMB imports the expm generic from the Matrix package, and then adds an AD method. Example here:

example(ADmatrix)


On Mon, Aug 5, 2024 at 3:51 PM Jan-Ole Koslik <janole...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi Kasper, 

looking at the AD matrix methods, there it shows expm(x) which is however not exported from RTMB (as compared to e.g. RTMB::diag()).

Is there a way to just compute expm(A) if A is a dense matrix that allows for AD?

I found expAv(), but I'm not sure I understand how it works.

Thanks in advance,
Ole
